title: The quotient-unit tuple is annihilated by one minus shift
statement: For a prime l, finite E/Q_l, scheme Y and complex P, form the strict quotient tower D(P) of the multiplication-cone descent construction. The product tuple of actual quotient units has composite zero with the strict difference 1-s. Consequently the zero shifted cochain and this tuple satisfy the mapping-cocone lift condition.

source.place: Clause (2), pullback commutes with reductions, and clause (3), second paragraph: agent-formulated identification of the specified inverse-image comparison with the completion unit. Compare Stacks derived.tex Tag 08TC (definition-derived-limit) and the explicit cone map of def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison (b).

proof.text: Project the composite to each factor. The result is the nth quotient unit minus the next quotient unit followed by transition. Compatibility makes it zero. Product joint monicity and zero differential of the zero cochain give the displayed lift condition.

proof_origin.place: Clauses (2)–(3), explicit strict quotient augmentation and multiplication cancellation.

theorem trfStrictQuotientUnit_condition
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) :
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ (-1) 0
        (0 : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain P
          (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ ((trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y).obj P).obj (op n)) (-1)) +
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom
        (Pi.lift (f := fun n : ℕ ↦
          ((trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y).obj P).obj (op n))
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ unrestrictedTowerUnit l E Y P n) ≫
          trfQuotientDifference l E Y P) = 0
